verdict.rationale: Mailgun does not document a native AI-insights/dashboard feature that proactively surfaces suggestions inside its product UI; the closest capability is the MCP server, which lets an external AI assistant query stats, troubleshoot DNS, and answer questions conversationally using Mailgun data — a form of AI-derived insight, but it requires a separate AI client rather than being built into the product. missing for 10: an in-product AI analytics/insights feature, evidence of proactive AI-generated suggestions, and any hands-on validation of the MCP-based insight quality.
